name: ChatOrder + OrderZ + MyFojo WhatsApp/own-channel OO peers
summary: Three regional commission-free own-channel peers (Composio FETCH 2026-09-04): (1) **ChatOrder** (UK) — WhatsApp-first AI ordering; markets 0% commission but charges **30p–99p per order** PAYG (capped 99p; first 10 free); Stripe Connect; QR→WA; CRM. Flat per-order fee ≠ % KEEP class — watch only under fee pause. (2) **OrderZ** (Singapore) — zero-commission own-channel takeaway/delivery + PayNow + live POS/KDS; anti-GrabFood/Foodpanda 25–30% pitch. (3) **MyFojo** (India) — WhatsApp native OO 0% vs Zomato/Swiggy; Petpooja POS sync; UPI; claims 1000+ restaurants. Watch with Zippi/VoiceZero/BoostOrder/WaveOrder; not Meta FBE.
what_it_does: WhatsApp / own-channel restaurant ordering that keeps marketplace commissions off the ticket and routes orders to kitchen/POS.
how_competitors_use_it: UK takeaways QR→WhatsApp AI cart; SG independents replace Grab tablets with branded OO; IN restaurants migrate Swiggy/Zomato volume to WA.
gap: Regional (UK/SG/IN) — sharpens anti-marketplace chat OO set; ChatOrder per-order fee is teachable but fee pause blocks dogfood
operator_ask: No fee dogfood. Auth unlocks still priority.
not_this: Not Meta FBE. Not fee dogfood. Not forecasting. ChatOrder 30p–99p is flat per-order — do not label as first_party_pct_fee.
